comment: The first command of the game is a kick with a count of 14. Two repeats are answered. The third is aimed at the pet, and Escape at "Really attack the kitten?" makes dokick() return without ECMD_TIME, so rhack() calls reset_cmd_vars(), which zeroes gm.multi and drops the eleven repeats left. The ^A that follows reports that no command is available to repeat. No earlier command has run cmd.c reset_cmd_vars(), so svc.context.run still holds the zero C starts it with: hack.c lookaround(), which allmain.c moveloop_core() calls before each repeat, returns at `svc.context.run == 0` without examining the squares next to the hero. A square there would stop a run. The seed, date and character were chosen for this recipe.
